messages:
deploy-bot: Starting deploy -> environment: private-eu-west-1 (dedicated). tag: v2.4.1-hotfix. commit: 9f3a2b7. change window: 23:00-01:00 UTC. owner: @sami. canary: 2 instances. rolling steps: 10% increments. release notes: kv-cache fallback fix. /cc @release-manager :rocket:
sami (SRE): ack, watching metrics and trace. will escalate on anomalies.
marta (infra): heads-up: node image 2025.11 has kernel 6.2; the new build pulls an io_uring optimization. confirming compatibility with our GPU drivers.
jordan (eng): noted. if canary shows >5% p99 regression on kv-heavy flows, hold and pin to v2.4.0.
deploy-bot: Canary step 1/5 finished — 2/2 canaries up. smoke checks OK. latency: baseline +2% p50, p95 within SLOs. logs: no errors. token throughput stable.
qa-runner: ran quick perf harness vs canary. seeing small regressions on long-context (>=4k tokens): median +10%. capturing traces and diffs.
sami (SRE): seeing lower cache hit ratio on canary, possibly from new invalidation logic. pausing rollout now. paused at 23:17 UTC by @sami.
deploy-bot: Rollout paused. affected hosts: 3 canary hosts. action_required: decide pin or rollback. suggested options: rollback to v2.4.0 or pin dedicated clusters to legacy routing.
release-manager: Proposal: pin dedicated clusters to v2.4.0 for 6h, rollback canary hosts only, then ship hotfix branch to fix cache invalidation. Thoughts? @marta @jordan
marta (infra): pin is safer. rollback canaries to v2.4.0 and resume canary with invalidation flag disabled if possible.
jordan (eng): I can cut a patch branch immediately but prefer pin + patch deploy in off-peak. start rollback on canaries only, keep rest halted.
sami (SRE): initiating canary rollback now. command: kubectl rollout undo deployment/ri-runtime --to-revision=$(rev:v2.4.0) (internal steps omitted). rolling back 3 hosts. ETA ~8m. shifting canary traffic back to v2.4.0, alerting affected customers.
deploy-bot: Rollback started: v2.4.1-hotfix -> v2.4.0 on canaries. rollback progress: 1/3 completed, 2/3 in progress.
deploy-bot: Rollback completed for canaries. all canaries now on v2.4.0. latency and cache-hit ratios back to baseline. rollout remains paused pending patch.
release-manager: Scheduling patch rollout at 02:30 UTC after infra verification. creating postmortem note and linking PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/4389
sami (SRE): :white_check_mark: good. leaving extra KV cache debug logging enabled for next run.
jordan (eng): PR opened and linked to INF-2123. I'll attach harness results and traces. thanks everyone — will wait for infra thumbs up.
deploy-bot: Deploy thread closed for now. Summary: canary rollback to v2.4.0 completed, recommended pin for dedicated clusters, patch PR opened. tag v2.4.0 active. Reopen when ready to resume testing or rollforward.
